shortDescription: Resource module for Images Id Sites Site Id Untag Golden

options.name: deviceRoles
options.description: Device Roles. Available value will be CORE, DISTRIBUTION, UNKNOWN, ACCESS, BORDER ROUTER.

options.name: deviceTags
options.description: Device tags can be fetched fom API https //developer.cisco.com/docs/dna-center/#!get-tag.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. Software image identifier is used for golden tagging or intent to tag it. The value of `id` can be obtained from the response of the API `/dna/intent/api/v1/images?imported=true&isAddonImages=false` for the base image and `/dna/images/{id}/addonImages` where `id` will be the software image identifier of the base image.

options.name: productNameOrdinal
options.description: The product name ordinal is a unique value for each network device product. `productNameOrdinal` can be obtained from the response of API `/dna/intent/api/v1/siteWiseProductNam...

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId path parameter. Site identifier for tagged image or intent to tag it. The default value is global site id. See https //developer.cisco.com/docs/dna-center(#!get-site) for `siteId`.

options.name: supervisorProductNameOrdinal
options.description: The supervisor engine module ordinal is a unique value for each supervisor module. `supervisorProductNameOrdinal` can be obtained from the response of API `/dna/intent/api/v1/siteWiseProductNames?siteId=<siteId>`.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
